subject: Next steps: support access model, data residency & retention for NeptuneFin
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@neptunefin.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: security@neptunefin.com
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 15:22:00 -0400
Subject: Post-call: PIIs, retention & emergency access (NeptuneFin)

Thanks for the demo earlier — good run-through. I wanted to capture the things my security and ops team will need to evaluate us moving forward. High level asks below, please escalate to engineering where needed:

- PII classification: will Redwood see raw PII in logs or traces when we send transcripts? Need details on masking and redaction options.
- Data retention: default retention for request/response logs and for embeddings; ability to set per-tenant retention.
- Logging controls: access to request logs, redaction controls, and auditability for support activity.
- Data residency: can we pin production workload to us-east-1 and have data residency guarantees?
- Support access / break-glass: what is the least-privileged path for support engineers to observe or replay requests? Process + timeboxed exception windows?

If you can reply with a short model (what we should expect), links to docs, and any artifacts (runbook / SOC2 evidence) that would be super helpful. Also happy to schedule a short 30-min security deep-dive with your SE.

Thanks,
Liam
Head of Infrastructure
Neptune Financial
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@neptunefin.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 17:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call: PIIs, retention & emergency access (NeptuneFin)

Liam — thanks for the concise list. Captured and routed below with proposed next steps. Short summary first, then attachments/links and proposed times for an SE deep-dive.

Short model (TL;DR)
- PII handling: Redwood does not store raw request bodies beyond configured retention windows. We provide request-level redaction hooks and an option to enable client-side tokenization prior to send.
- Retention: default logging retention is 30 days; per-tenant retention configurable down to 0 days or up to 7 years on Dedicated/Private.
- Logs & audit: audit logs capture who accessed KV/requests and include request hashes; support access is logged and surfaced in Console.
- Data residency: Hosted workloads can be pinned to a region (us-east-1 available today). Private customers get full control.
- Break-glass: timeboxed support sessions via short-lived roles (1h default), explicit customer approval via Console or DocuSign link; audit trail retained.

Attachments included in this thread: redwood-support-playbook.pdf (break-glass flow + roles), network-allowlist-template.csv, sample-soc2-snapshot.txt (high level evidence).

Concrete next steps
1) SE deep-dive (30m) to walk through playbook and confirm config for your environment — options: Wed 03/10 10:00-10:30 ET or Thu 03/11 14:00-14:30 ET. Tell me what works.
2) I will share a proposed RBAC matrix for your ops/support roles and a retention policy example matching your compliance needs.
3) If you want staging access, we'll provision a scoped tenant with sample data redaction enabled — we'll need a short signed DPA amendment (I included DocuSign link below).

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnefn@neptunefin.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 19:11:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call: PIIs, retention & emergency access (NeptuneFin)

Liam / Vivek — quick technical clarifications and what I'll cover on the SE call: 

- Redaction: we support server-side redaction rules (regex/tag) that remove PII from logs, plus client-side tokenization libraries for additional protection. Example: credit card PANs and SSNs can be masked at ingestion; we can return redacted request bodies in Console.
- Embeddings: by default embedding vectors are not stored beyond the configured retention. For Dedicated/Private, customers can opt out of logging embeddings entirely.
- Audit logs: immutable audit stream to customer-managed Cloud Storage (optional). Each support action (session start, replay request, role escalation) emits an audit event.
- Break-glass mechanics: short-lived IAM roles, tied to an approval payload; we support SAML OIDC integrations so you can approve from your own IdP if desired.

I'll attach the support playbook and an allowlist template. On the call I can walk the exact Console flows and the minimal RBAC rules you'd need to allow support read-only access to request logs without exposing raw request bodies.

—Aditya
Principal Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-support-playbook.pdf, network-allowlist-template.csv
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@neptunefin.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: security@neptunefin.com
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 08:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call: PIIs, retention & emergency access (NeptuneFin)

Appreciate the detail. A couple of clarifications from our side before the SE deep-dive:

- Residency confirmation: can you guarantee production request bodies never leave us-east-1 when pinned? We need contractual language for this.
- Staging access scope: we'd like a sandbox tenant where redaction is enforced server-side and examples of the replay logs (hashes only) so we can run our audit.
- DPA amendment: send the DocuSign and I'll route it to legal.

Proposed time: Thu 03/11 14:00 ET works for our security lead. Please send the calendar invite and SE dial-in.

Thanks,
Liam
From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@neptunefin.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 09:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call: PIIs, retention & emergency access (NeptuneFin)

Liam — thanks, we can take care of the items below. Quick notes to address each: 

- Residency guarantee: for hosted us-east-1 pinned deployments we include a contractual clause restricting data transit outside the region for request/response bodies and logs; I'll attach the clause to the DocuSign envelope for your counsel to review.
- Sandbox tenant: we'll provision a scoped tenant with server-side redaction enabled, and seed it with synthetic examples. We'll also provide a 'replay-preview' file that contains request hashes and metadata (no raw text) for your auditing.
- Break-glass flow: support sessions require an approval token (Console or IdP) and are limited to 1 hour by default. All actions generate immutable audit events; we can stream those to your storage account.

I'll send the DocuSign link and a calendar invite for Thu 03/11 14:00 ET with the SE and myself on the call. If your legal wants the residency clause ahead of the DocuSign envelope, tell me and I'll paste it into the body of the email.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments in thread: sample-soc2-snapshot.txt
